name: KALM (Keep, Add, Less, More)
trigger: Teams experiencing process fatigue that need to modulate the intensity of existing activities rather than reinvent their workflow.
canvasLine: 4 Quadrants: Keep, Add, Less, More · 60 min

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; this is tuning, not rebuilding.
Gather data (15m): sort current practices into Keep, Add, Less, More.
Generate insights (20m): name the capacity Less frees and where More spends it.
Decide (15m): put a number on every Less commitment; one owner each.
Close (5m): confirm the new agreements in one sentence each.

action: Less time in standup becomes a hard ten-minute timer with status moved to the channel: owner and start date.
provenance: Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.
